trickyParts: Code in a table cell whose text holds a | right after an odd run of backslashes has no GFM spelling once \\| ends a cell. API writes (replace, delete by quote, accepted suggestion) that leave it are refused with TableCodePipeError naming the table, cell and header; a browser edit holding it is rendered with that | as text after the code (codePipesOutOfCode). A table that already held the shape does not block later writes (replacementBroke).

A header the browser reads as wider than its delimiter row no longer makes a table in Go either (it stays a paragraph, as in the browser); insert_test.go's '| A11 | new \\| extra |' case is now refused as too wide on both paths, by design.

TestUnescapeTablePipesLeavesTheTreeGoldmarksTransformerDoes compares against goldmark's own transformer, which cannot judge cells split later; it now skips inputs where a split happens and keeps generating until 5,000 are compared.
